Malicious code in supplyhub (npm)

  • supplyhub

The npm package `supplyhub` is a credential / SSH-key stealer. Its `package.json` declares a `postinstall` lifecycle hook (`postinstall: node postinstall.js`) that executes automatically on `npm install`, before the package is ever imported. `postinstall.js` uses `fs.readFileSync` to read the user's SSH private key (`~/.ssh/id_rsa`) and the process environment (`/proc/self/environ` — where CI/cloud tokens and npm tokens live), and gathers account/host identity via `os.userInfo()`; it also references `/etc/passwd`.
